newsitem.title: USA: Ontario Hydro sees Pickering nuke on line Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Ontario Hydro sees Pickering nuke on line Sunday.

text.p: Ontario Hydro said Wednesday that the 540 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at its Pickering generating station will likely resume electricity production this Sunday.
Unit 8, also rated at 540 MW, is scheduled to restart on May 18, while unit 4 will likely return to service in August, a company spokeswoman added.

The Pickering plant, with a total of eight units east of Toronto, Ontario, has been experiencing outages since April 20, 1996, when there was a problem with a backup valve on an emergency cooling system.
The remaining units were brought back on line by last October.
Ontario Hydro, including its Darlington nuclear power plant, has an overall in-service generation capacity of just over 29,000 MW.
